final_assessment: The system blind pair walked as ONE walk, per R-crc-4. Both halves merged: 8 external (GPT-5 Codex) + 9 fresh (clean-context Opus) = 17 findings, 2 overlapping, 15 distinct, ZERO CRITICAL from either half and ZERO stale under pushback. Thirteen took the obvious-fix lane and two the decision lane, both ratified by Sal (E7 as option A, F7 as option A). The pair earned its cost: overlap was 2 of 15, and capture-recapture on 9 and 8 with 2 shared puts the population near 36, so roughly 58 percent of what exists was still unfound after two independent reads. Each half also found what the other could not. Codex alone found the projection layer defect (formatChangeStatus reconstructing every row unconditionally, putting budget back as an undefined-valued key on the public object after computeGateStates had correctly omitted it), the passed-gate reason still saying "converged with" in the change whose thesis is that the engine no longer computes convergence, the dangling normative reference to a matching rule clause (c) took with it, and the two FORWARD-LOOKING architecture instructions that still require budgetExhausted. The fresh half alone found trail.ts, the fourth version pin, the touchpoints divergence, and four record-level defects in the change is own artifacts. Where they overlapped, Codex was the more complete both times, including a third unaccounted scenario rewrite the fresh half missed. The diagnosis both halves reached independently is the one worth carrying: the engine fields were deleted with real rigour and the PROSE around them was swept by instance rather than by class, so this walk swept by VOCABULARY instead. Nine sites for budget-as-ceiling, both sites for the dangling match key, every surviving mention of the retired vocabulary across comments, spec prose, projections, tests and records. Two process notes. My first probe of the touchpoints finding read the wrong JSON key and returned null; the finding stood and my instrument was wrong, which is the rc01 lesson landing on the walker.
